scenes.heading: GIVE YOUR AI *GOOD DESIGN* SENSE
scenes.sub: impeccable · design vocabulary for coding agents
scenes.say: Your AI writes code fast. But does it write code that looks good? Impecable gives your coding agent a design vocabulary.

scenes.heading: impeccable
scenes.say: It's called impeccable. It's a design vocabulary that plugs into your coding agent. You steer with polish and bolder, you review with critique.

scenes.heading: HOW IT WORKS
scenes.say: It's a set of agent skills built in Rust. Your AI agent loads them, and now it knows what polished code looks like. Not just valid code, but clean, intentional design.

scenes.heading: 92,814 ★ AND GROWING
scenes.say: Ninety two thousand stars. Two thousand more today. The anti-slop movement is real, and impeccable is at the center of it.

scenes.heading: ADD IT TO YOUR AGENT
scenes.say: Add one config file to your AI agent setup. It works with Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex. The skills load automatically.

scenes.heading: THE HONEST CATCH
scenes.say: It's a vocabulary, not a magic wand. Your AI still needs to understand the problem. But with impeccable, it will at least stop generating slop.
Stop accepting ugly code from your AI. Comment POLISH and follow for tools like this.
